slides.title: BAANYARD
slides.tagline: Stay with rural hosts like visiting relatives — authentic stays, goods & stories from rural communities worldwide.
slides.taglineTh: ไปเยี่ยมญาติชนบท · ที่พัก สินค้า และเรื่องราวจริงจากชุมชนทั่วโลก

slides.title: Two gaps, one longing
bullets: City guests seek warmth, safe food stories, and real belonging.
Rural communities hold hidden assets — crafts, stays, wisdom — but lack digital reach.
Global travelers want authenticity without leaving trust, language, or payment behind.

slides.title: A countryside “third place”
htmlBullets: Barn marketplace — homemade goods from the village
Trust tools — translation, currency, storytelling, video, in-app pay

slides.title: Barn + Yard, Naga + Garuda
slides.bodyHtml: BAANYARD = Barn (โรงนา — the granary of rice and wisdom) + Yard (ลาน — an open ground for relatives to gather). Our mark balances Naga (นาค — land- and water-rooted host communities) with Garuda (ครุฑ — protection, reach, trust) so neither side is erased.
bullets: “อุษาคเนย์เป็นญาติกัน” — Southeast Asia, all kin.
Naga carries the weight of place; Garuda carries the shelter of the platform.

slides.title: Connection is the product
slides.body: Wellness travel and community tourism are rising while many safe, culture-rich rural regions remain under-served by tech that fits low-tech hosts and high-tech guests alike.

slides.title: Thailand seed → global rural network
slides.bodyHtml: MVP narrative starts in Thailand (Sri Songkhram) and expands to rural Laos, Vietnam, Shan hills, islands, and beyond — wherever culture is rich and digital access is uneven.

slides.title: One app: pitch meets live product
slides.body: Guest book/buy · Host list in 3 steps · Admin for Country Thailand with branch & HQ sync — all live in the product below this deck (mock data where the backend isn't wired yet).
bullets: Country Admin reads real MOTS Travel Link province data and predicts which BAANYARD products/services fit each province

bullets: Seed story: Sri Songkhram heirloom rice, indigo & homestays
Community leaders & อสม. guardians anchor trust on the ground
University certifiers (prospective) validate quality over time
KOL / "สะพานเชื่อม" bridges carry stories to city & global audiences

slides.title: Not another generic OTA
slides.bodyHtml: Generic OTAs and marketplaces optimize scale listings. BAANYARD optimizes relatives-in-the-countryside authenticity, homemade goods, and tools that close the digital inequality gap without erasing culture.
